name: Celeste Dalla Porta
bio: Celeste Dalla Porta was born on December 24, 1997 in Monza, Lombardy, Italy. She is an actress, known for Parthenope (2024), Red Mirror (2022) and Beyond Passion (2020).

credits.title: Costanera
credits.overview: Diego is a talented but restless young trumpeter who decides to leave Rome—and his girlfriend, Alice—behind to join his mentor, Nacho, in Argentina. However, on the other side of the world, neither contracts nor certainty about the future await him, and the journey soon proves to be more existential than professional.

credits.title: Parthenope
credits.overview: Parthenope, born in the sea near Naples in 1950, is beautiful, enigmatic, and intelligent. She is shamelessly courted by many. However, beauty comes at a cost.

credits.title: Who's Afraid of Dr. Kramer?
credits.overview: Shortly before the premiere of the play, quarantine is announced and four actors: Chiara, Giorgio, Antonio and Valentino find themselves in isolation. In moments of despair, when they return to the mistakes of the past and test the strength of relationships, they may feel that madness is the only way out.
